name: NTE Damage Chain Reaction
description: Captures a real player-to-target CharacterOnDamaged event and, when enabled, continuously reapplies only the exact Core-validated HTAbilitySystemComponent GameplayEffect call against the same target at a configurable Game-tick interval, creating a damage-chain reaction. A chain stops when no fresh matching damage event arrives within 2 seconds or the feature is disabled. It does not replay player input, skills, or animations and does not directly write target HP.
author: Anomaly
